name: Mouse camera
author: Jaykaymaster
description: Rotate the map camera with the mouse, like in most 3D games.

defaultParameters.name: Enable on start
defaultParameters.description: 1 = camera follows the mouse from the start, 0 = only after the Enable mouse camera command

defaultParameters.name: Sensitivity
defaultParameters.description: Mouse speed in percent (100 = normal, 200 = twice as fast)

defaultParameters.name: Rotation smoothing
defaultParameters.description: How much the rotation is smoothed, in percent (0 = none, 30 = light, 60 = strong)

defaultParameters.name: Start vertical angle
defaultParameters.description: Vertical camera angle set when a map starts (degrees, lower = closer to the ground, 0 = do not change)

defaultParameters.name: Wheel zoom
defaultParameters.description: 1 = the mouse wheel zooms the camera in and out, 0 = off

defaultParameters.name: Zoom speed
defaultParameters.description: How much one wheel notch changes the zoom, in percent (5 = gentle)

defaultParameters.name: Max zoom in
defaultParameters.description: Strongest zoom in, in percent (150 = 1.5 times closer, 100 = no zooming in)

defaultParameters.name: Max zoom out
defaultParameters.description: Strongest zoom out, in percent (70 = 30% wider view, 100 = no zooming out)

defaultParameters.name: Keep camera inside map
defaultParameters.description: EXPERIMENTAL: 1 = the camera is not allowed to go past the edge of the map (may cause stuttering), 0 = off

defaultParameters.name: Map edge margin
defaultParameters.description: How many squares past the map edge the camera may go (only with Keep camera inside map)

defaultParameters.name: Avoid obstacles
defaultParameters.description: EXPERIMENTAL: 1 = the camera moves closer to the character when something is in the way (may cause stuttering), 0 = off

commands.name: Enable mouse camera
commands.description: Turns on camera rotation with the mouse

commands.name: Disable mouse camera
commands.description: Turns off camera rotation with the mouse and releases the mouse

commands.name: Enable wheel zoom
commands.description: Turns on zooming with the mouse wheel

commands.name: Disable wheel zoom
commands.description: Turns off zooming with the mouse wheel
